## $whoami

Red team operator at Advens. I design and run adversary emulation engagements that replicate the tradecraft of real-world threat groups against clients' systems, people, and premises. My work covers the full intrusion chain: initial access (phishing, exposed services, adversary-in-the-middle), lateral movement and objective completion, physical intrusion, and the development of custom offensive tooling I deploy in the field.
